metadata.name: Limacina helicina Environmental and Chemical Measurements
metadata.description: This dataset contains environmental and chemical measurements related to the species Limacina helicina, collected in a laboratory setting. The data includes various parameters such as temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, pH, partial pressure of CO2, and saturation states of aragonite and calcite. The measurements were taken at a single location (48.43° N, -126.23° E) in the year 2019.
